# Safety and output boundaries

**Use this formula only for unseeded, local teaching exercises.** Unseeded means no existing content is supplied, retrieved, paraphrased, summarized or used as an example to shape new material. This has nothing to do with a pseudo-random seed, initializing an empty database, or placing a clue. Those mechanisms do not change the origin of their contents.

| Before this action | Boundary |
|---|---|
| Opening a generation session | Establish eligibility through your organization's process outside the prompt. The decision must cover the workshop purpose, unseeded source, audience, effective model and actual service, including fallback. If the route or context cannot be verified, use the instruction-only workshop without a model. |
| Supplying inputs | Only newly invented short labels, an optional invented airline code, and a new or empty external local destination are accepted. Do not request, attach, search for or read other inputs: no documents, transcripts, records, prior fictional examples, URLs, screenshots, repositories or hidden workspace context. This applies to maintainers too. If such material entered the context, stop; do not quote it back, sanitize it or turn it into examples. |
| Evaluating existing material | Reading fixtures into a model is a separate use even if the task is called evaluation. Neither the workshop decision nor prior publication, a license, sign-in or a local origin record grants it. No fixture staging or live evaluation is supported here. |
| Sharing outputs | The public artifact is the instruction set. Keep generated data, screenshots, personas, backlog and other derivatives local and marked not cleared. Cross-team use requires its own decision; external distribution requires prior approval under the applicable dataset process and agreement on the release disclosure. A public branch or commit already distributes its contents. |

Teaching people is not model training. This skill does not handle research, training a model, model release, requests for seeded generation, or organizational approval. Refer unsupported work to the appropriate owner outside this workflow, without submitting the content here. A skill can guide a new interaction; it cannot intercept past prompts, inspect every host's routing or grant permissions.

Keep the deliberately flawed exercise isolated. Do not use real passenger, employee, customer or credential data or deploy the exercise publicly. Draw original graphics; use only open-source components and include applicable licenses and attributions. Do not use an open license as evidence of permission for model input or dataset release.
